description: A parent tracking their child's food allergy elimination diet needs to create a professional spreadsheet for the allergist appointment. Open the source data at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/reintroduction_notes.txt. Create a structured analysis spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/reintroduction_analysis.xlsx with columns for Period, Food_Introduced, Skin_Score, Digestive_Score, Energy_Score, Avg_Symptom_Severity (calculated formula), and Trigger_Status (IF formula). Include a summary section calculating trigger count, safe food count, and identifying the highest severity food. This medical documentation is needed for insurance approval of allergy testing.
